summary: Notevoro backend + frontend tested. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passing (auth signup/duplicate/wrong-password/me/error envelope, spaces idempotency+duplicate+plan gating+isolation, items CRUD for notes/tasks/projects/events/documents+versions, records capability gating, files upload+download, search, export, chat direct-dedup+client_id idempotency+cross-space 403, voro agents+503-with-no-usage-consumption+context, billing change-plan+grace, webhook secret+idempotency, health live/ready, registry >100 caps). Frontend: login as alex works, brain-home renders with Voro card and Spaces, opening 'Product Development' team space -> Space Home fits 1440x900 viewport (scrollHeight==innerHeight), voro-panel present, Voro 'ask' returns 503 gracefully ('not configured' visible, no infinite spinner). Tasks/Notes/Library flows all functional (task create shows in list, note autosave 'Saved', add-habits adds capability + space-nav-habits appears + remove-habits present). Zero page errors, zero uncaught exceptions.
critical_code_review_comments: Voro ask endpoint order-of-operations is correct: 503 raised BEFORE consume() so usage is not deducted (verified by before/after usage assertion).
Idempotency-Key on POST /spaces returns cached 201 response for retries; correctly avoids duplicate space creation.
Webhook uses insert-based idempotency (BillingEvent unique event_id) with IntegrityError catch — clean pattern.
chat.py send_message dedupe via (conversation_id, client_id) uniqueness — good.
items.crud factory: nested function-closure endpoints keep the file compact; consider splitting >700-line files if they grow.
server.py exception handlers registered before include_router — fine; ApiError envelope { code, message, request_id } is consistent.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed spaces/users; safe to leave (soft state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest locally (in preview shell the frontend env is not auto-exported to pytest process). Frontend flows not yet exercised end-to-end here: dual-context chat realtime (alex+sarah), Files upload UI, Calendar/Meetings creation UI, Team invite UI, Settings billing UI, global Cmd/K search, notifications menu, logout. All corresponding BACKEND endpoints are green so UI wiring is the only remaining risk.
